title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 2.4
scope: Affirmative answer to the concrete existence question: one entire function may have different finite exceptional values at two Julia rays.
verified_witness: erf(z), with exceptional values 1 at pi/4 and -1 at 3pi/4
historical_credit: S. Toppila (1970), as reported by the primary problem-list update and Hwang (1977)
K. F. Barth and W. J. Schneider (1972), as reported by Hwang (1977)
